ssr.rule: Verified NBBO, eligible aggressive buy prints, queue depletion, price-test cancellation and a 15-minute timeout. Quotes alone do not fill a short limit.

definitions.edge: Prior completed other issuers only. Gross return is shrunk toward zero; the lower bound is an issuer bootstrap estimate. Framework mechanisms and reconciled financing are separate matching features, never additive return bonuses.
definitions.sizing: Search feasible whole-share quantities using costs at each proposed size, commission minima, confidence-bound edge, fractional sizing, prior ADV, concurrent positions, margin and joint squeeze budgets.
definitions.holding: Next open after announcement or after the split; 1, 5, 10 or 20 sessions. Daily-bar brackets use the adverse stop first when both boundaries occur in one bar. These are conditional benchmarks, not observed executions.
definitions.borrow: Sum rounded nominal collateral times daily APR / 360 across settled calendar days for every prior holding scenario. Actual fee records are kept separate from forecasts. Pre-borrow fees/minimum days are explicit account assumptions.
definitions.frameworks: Every route is reviewed or explicitly unknown/N/A. Contrary evidence blocks a selected mechanism; only documented mandatory vetoes exclude other mechanisms. No full conviction is manufactured from a numerical screen.
definitions.validation: All historical periods were explored. Calibration is diagnostic. The policy freezes a prospective start; future forecasts must be archived before entry and never rebuilt using their outcomes.

limits: Catalogue and discovery counts retain unpriced/unverified names; full-announcement completeness is not claimed.
Daily bars do not prove tradability, stop fills, SSR fills, inventory, borrow approval, dividend liabilities or settlement of fractional split entitlements.
All included P&L is a conditional execution/carry scenario. Strict results remain blocked without primary reviews, identity, financing, fresh entry approval and observed execution evidence.
Joint daily highs are a conservative funding diagnostic. A reported margin breach invalidates the scenario; it is not treated as a funded strategy return.
Source prices are verified nominal venue observations; missing bars remain unresolved in coverage, never silently converted into winning returns.
The bootstrap does not establish the probability of rare squeezes; separate +200% name and sleeve stress limits remain binding.
